The more data you give it, the better it gets at predicting where it should go, but once you stop giving it new data, it'll start making mistakes.

To prevent overfitting, we often split our dataset into training and testing sets. We train the model on the training set and then test it on the testing set to see how well it performs. This way, we're not relying solely on the training data and can adjust the model accordingly.
